LanguageData.MA_TerrainDesc: Paint any terrain – soil, sand, water, stone, floors. Click to choose the terrain (right-click to change it), then drag a rectangle, oval or line. Water is never put under buildings or people.
LanguageData.MA_PlantsDesc: Plant trees, bushes, grass or crops. Choose the plant and the density, then drag over the area.
LanguageData.MA_ClearDesc: Remove plants, rocks, filth, items or everything in the area. People and your own buildings are never removed.
LanguageData.MA_MountainDesc: Raise a mountain of any rock or ore, or change the roof (overhead mountain, thin rock roof, none).
LanguageData.MA_DeepDesc: Paint resources for the deep drill (steel, plasteel, uranium, chemfuel …) or remove them.
LanguageData.MA_ObjectDesc: Everything in one list: buildings, items, animals, people, ruins, filth – from the game and all mods. Q / E rotate.
LanguageData.MA_NoSpace: There is a person or your building in the way.
LanguageData.MA_UndoDesc: Undo the last change of Map Architect (also Ctrl+Z). Up to 40 steps.
LanguageData.MA_SmoothDesc: Instantly smooth natural stone floor in the area.
LanguageData.MA_FogAddDesc: Cover the area with fog of war (never over your colonists).
LanguageData.MA_BiomeTreesDesc: Plant trees that grow wild in this biome, by their natural share. Right-click: density.
LanguageData.MA_BiomeGrassDesc: Plant grass, bushes and other wild plants of this biome. Right-click: density.
LanguageData.MA_MountainQuickDesc: Raise a mountain of this map's rock with a natural roof.
LanguageData.MA_RoofBuildDesc: Put a normal built roof over the area at once.
LanguageData.MA_RoofRemoveAllDesc: Remove every roof in the area – built ones, thin rock and overhead mountain.
LanguageData.MA_FinishDesc: Finish all blueprints and frames in the area at once, for free (buildings and floors).
LanguageData.MA_RepairDesc: Repair buildings and items in the area to full health at once.
LanguageData.MA_SnowRemoveDesc: Clear snow from the area at once (plants can grow there again).
LanguageData.MA_SnowAddDesc: Cover the area (outdoors) with deep snow.
LanguageData.MA_PollutionRemoveDesc: Clean polluted ground in the area.
LanguageData.MA_PollutionAddDesc: Pollute the ground in the area.
LanguageData.MA_ExtinguishDesc: Put out every fire in the area at once.
LanguageData.MA_GrowUpDesc: Plants in the area grow to full size at once.
LanguageData.MA_ObjSpecialDesc: Geysers, vents, ancient things, ruins, archotech, monoliths, stone chunks – from the game and all mods.
LanguageData.MA_ObjBuildingsDesc: Any building from the game, DLCs and mods, grouped like the Architect menu. Choose the material after the building. Q / E rotate.
LanguageData.MA_ObjItemsDesc: Any item: food, resources, medicine, weapons, apparel, artifacts … grouped by category, with a mod filter.
LanguageData.MA_ObjAnimalsDesc: Any animal or insect from the game and mods. "Enemy" makes it a manhunter, "your colony" makes it tame.
LanguageData.MA_ObjPeopleDesc: People of any faction and race, mechanoids, entities. Choose whom they belong to: nobody, your colony, or the enemy (they attack).
LanguageData.MA_ObjFilthDesc: Blood, dirt, ash, slime and other filth or stains.
LanguageData.MA_SurvivalDesc: Map Architect becomes part of the game instead of a free editor: only the terraforming tools are shown (terrain, smoothing, mountains and natural roofs, deep resources). They need the Fabrication research and every use takes materials from storage on the map – a floor what it costs to build, anything else steel per cell; ore veins and deep resources also cost what they give. The change is still instant. Undo gives nothing back.
LanguageData.MA_SurvivalResearch: Survival mode: terraforming needs the research {0}.
